lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: So they're both dead...
The condition of the corpses was strange.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I know. I saw it too.
Do you know anything?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: How am I supposed to know?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: There has to be a reason for all this,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: but I have no way of knowing, and I don't want to know.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: They're dead, and that's all that matters.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: There's no one left to talk about the past with me anymore.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Isn't life grand?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Let me ask you something.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: If I hadn't gotten injured

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: and been able to continue the mission,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: do you think that would have changed things?
Sure. There would have been one more corpse.
Maybe.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: How comforting.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Hehe, you fool.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: That wouldn't have changed a thing.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: At any rate, it's all in the past now.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Let me ask one more thing.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: What's the difference between you and me?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: My friends and I worked really hard too,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: you know?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: We wanted to do our part, contribute to world peace

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: and protect our loved ones.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: So why did we end up like this,

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: while you get to bask in all the glory?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Why do you get treated like a savior while we get forgotten?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: How do you explain that?

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I would have given anything

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: to be treated like you are.
I don't know.
I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Forget it, you don't need to answer.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: Take care.

lines.speaker: handsomecommander
lines.text: I don't think we'll be talking again.
